en.title: Anne Hathaway Pushed Hard for Julie Andrews in Princess Diaries 3
en.summary: Anne Hathaway reveals the extensive efforts made to secure Julie Andrews for the upcoming 'Princess Diaries 3'. Despite Hathaway's strong advocacy, the beloved icon has ultimately passed on the role.
en.body:
The magic of Genovia might feel a little less sparkling without its queen. **Anne Hathaway** has shared that she "pushed really hard" to convince Dame **Julie Andrews** to reprise her role as Queen Clarisse Renaldi in the forthcoming **Princess Diaries 3**. While Hathaway is set to return as Mia Thermopolis, the legendary **Julie Andrews** has declined to participate in the latest installment of the beloved Disney franchise, much to the disappointment of fans eagerly awaiting the film's 2026 release.

Hathaway recently spoke with The Hollywood Reporter about her efforts, emphasizing her desire to see the original queen grace the screen once more. "I want the women who were six when the first one came out to have the magic of that,” Hathaway explained, highlighting the generational impact of the original film and its sequel. However, **Julie Andrews**, the inimitable force behind Queen Clarisse, has made her decision clear. While the offer reportedly remains on the table should she ever change her mind, Hathaway has expressed understanding, stating, "Whatever she wants."

## The Royal Farewell

The absence of **Julie Andrews** is undoubtedly a significant moment for the **Princess Diaries** saga. Her regal presence, witty charm, and undeniable chemistry with **Anne Hathaway** were foundational to the franchise's success. For many, Queen Clarisse is as integral to the story as Mia herself. Hathaway acknowledged this, telling Entertainment Weekly that the "Mary Poppins" icon "brings magic with her wherever she goes," and that she will certainly miss that unique spark. The sentiment echoes the feelings of countless fans who grew up with the films, cherishing the mentor-mentee relationship between Mia and Clarisse.

## What Fans Are Saying

News of **Julie Andrews**'s departure has naturally sparked a flurry of reactions across social media and fan forums. While many express sadness and a touch of disappointment, the overarching sentiment is one of respect for **Andrews**'s decision. Fans understand that at 90 years old, she may have different priorities or simply wishes to step back from such demanding roles. The consensus seems to be that while her presence will be deeply missed, the love for the franchise and **Anne Hathaway**'s return remains strong. Many are now curious to see how the narrative will adapt without Queen Clarisse, and whether **Andrews**'s absence will be explained within the story or simply accepted as a new chapter.

## What's Next

With **Princess Diaries 3** officially slated for a 2026 release, the focus now shifts to **Anne Hathaway** and the creative team as they forge ahead. Details regarding the plot, supporting cast, and how the film will address the absence of Queen Clarisse have not yet been announced. Fans will be eagerly awaiting further updates as production begins on what promises to be a highly anticipated return to Genovia.
